content.content:
=== V4__invoices ===
-- Invoices: the owner bills work against a project. Each invoice belongs to one project
-- (project_id references project.id) and carries a monetary amount. Third domain table; a project's
-- detail screen lists its invoices and shows their total.
CREATE TABLE invoice (
    id         BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id),
    amount     DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL
);
=== V5__invoice_status ===
-- Invoices gain a payment status so the owner can mark one paid. New invoices default to UNPAID;
-- paying an invoice flips it to PAID (and audits the transition). Additive column on the existing
-- invoice table (V4); existing rows backfill to UNPAID.
ALTER TABLE invoice ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNPAID';
=== V6__invoice_amount_positive ===
-- An invoice must bill a real amount: enforce a positive amount at the schema level so an invoice
-- for zero (or a negative amount) can never be persisted (defence-in-depth behind the server and UI
-- validation). amount is already NOT NULL (V4); this adds the positivity check.
ALTER TABLE invoice
    ADD CONSTRAINT invoice_amount_positive
    CHECK (amount > 0);
=== V9__invoice_draft_default ===
-- Invoices now move through a lifecycle: DRAFT (just created) -> SENT (issued to the client) ->
-- PAID. A new invoice starts as a DRAFT, so change the status column's default accordingly. Additive
-- metadata change on the existing invoice table (V4/V5); existing rows keep their current status.
ALTER TABLE invoice ALTER COLUMN status SET DEFAULT 'DRAFT';
=== V13__tasks ===
-- Tasks: each project keeps a checklist of tasks. Each task has a title, belongs to one project
-- (project_id references project.id) and is either OPEN (done = FALSE) or DONE (done = TRUE). The
-- project's detail screen lists its tasks and lets the owner tick them off.
CREATE TABLE task (
    id         BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id),
    title      VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    done       BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
);
=== V3__projects ===
-- Projects: the owner tracks the work they do for a client. Each project has a name and belongs to
-- one client (client_id references client.id). Second domain table; joins to client for the name.
CREATE TABLE project (
    id        BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name      VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    client_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES client(id)
);

-- to one invoice (invoice_id references invoice.id) and records what is being charged for: a

    invoice_id  BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoice(id),
    description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    quantity    INT NOT NULL,
    unit_price  DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL
);

The full-stack change is complete and both `@core` tests pass.

## Summary

The change lets an invoice be built from **line items** (description, quantity, price each) with the total worked out automatically, instead of typing one figure.

**Database** (`V14__invoice_line_items.sql`)
- New `line_item` table (`invoice_id` FK, `description`, `quantity`, `unit_price`).
- Dropped the V6 `invoice_amount_positive` check so an invoice can start at `$0.00` before any lines are added; `invoice.amount` stays as the maintained total.

**Server** (OfficeFloor REST)
- `LineItem` entity + `LineItemRepository`, `LineItemView`, `NewLineItem`.
- `GET /api/invoices/{invoiceId}/lineitems` (`ListLineItemsLogic`) — lists the lines.
- `POST /api/invoices/{invoiceId}/lineitems` (`CreateLineItemLogic`) — validates, adds a line, and **re-totals** the invoice amount from its lines.
- Each endpoint is a new YAML + logic class (additive, no central router).
- `TestSupportController` now truncates `line_item` on reset and seeds invoices from their `lineItems` (computing the amount as the sum of qty × unit price).

**Front-end** (React, feature-local)
- New `InvoiceLineItems.tsx` detail view: `invoice-lineitems-table`, `lineitem-row-<id>` with `lineitem-description`, the add form (`lineitem-form-description/-qty/-unitprice/-submit`), and the `invoice-amount` total.
- `ProjectInvoices.tsx` gained an `invoice-open-<id>` button per row; opening an invoice swaps the list for the detail view (so only one `invoice-amount` is on the page at a time), and closing reloads the list so the row total reflects added lines.

All existing `data-testid` anchors were preserved. I ran `bin/e2e`: **2 passed**.

One note on a pre-existing, untested path: the legacy "Add invoice" form (`invoice-form-amount`) still creates a flat-amount invoice — I left it and its test-ids intact rather than removing them, so a flat invoice shows its typed amount in the list but `$0.00` in the line-items detail until lines are added. Happy to replace that form with a "create empty invoice" action if you'd prefer the single-figure entry fully gone.
